SOURCE NOTES

Compare like with like.

473 units from all 24 Armada, Cortex and Legion category pages on the official website, retrieved 14 November 2026. This is a bundled snapshot, not a live game feed.

Every available numeric unit-summary stat is selectable. Weapon reload, salvo, alpha and area of effect use the largest published value across the unit’s weapons; individual weapons appear in the unit details.

Laser damage falls with distance. Minimum values are calculated from the website’s weapon falloff percentages; maximum values retain the published unit DPS. For mixed weapons, falloff is weighted by each published weapon DPS. The ≈ symbol marks mixed-weapon estimates or a mismatch between weapon and unit totals. These are output bounds, not a simulation at a shared distance: weapons may have different ranges, and units outside weapon range deal no damage. No interpolation curve is assumed. Ratios divide the lower numerator by the upper denominator and vice versa; dividing a stat by itself is always 1. On logarithmic charts, zero endpoints cannot be plotted.

DPS is the website’s maximum combined weapon DPS, not a simulation. Target restrictions, armour, accuracy, bursts, EMP, special weapons and energy use can change combat results. Commander and special-weapon DPS can be extreme.

Missing stats stay missing, rather than becoming zero. Missing values are excluded from plots and rankings; log scales also exclude zero/negative values. Ratios require a positive denominator. Metal and energy remain separate currencies.

Bars start at zero on linear scales. Side-by-side bars are normalised separately per stat to the largest value in the comparison; longer does not always mean better.
